summary: The change adds the missing password step-up rate limiting and a shared re-login fallback wired into all shipped clients, with regression coverage; no actionable defect was found.

evidence: src/passport.ts:1107-1114 invokes allowPasswordAttempt before getPasswordCredential and verifyPassword in handleStepUpPassword, reusing the source and account password budgets.
tests/bun_test.ts adds regression coverage that exhausts the account and source password budgets through step-up requests and verifies no further verification work occurs.

public/reauthentication.js adds the shared re-login fallback, and auth.js, device.js, agent_tokens.js, admin_users.js and admin_projects.js all import it; src/passport.ts:3114-3121 allows the admin return paths.
src/passport.ts:3279-3280, src/assets.ts:18 and src/worker.ts:20 register the new asset, and tests/reauthentication_test.ts covers re-login, CSRF renewal and retrying the write.
